name: HHWO World Title
epitaph: The promotion's own top prize, created for its first pay-per-view, Legends 98 (30 August 1998), where a three-way match determined the first HHWO World Champion; by the fed's second-era Rebirth show (15 November 1998) the World Title had become a four-man tag-team ladder match and an eight-man tournament, a schema change this record notes without a traced lineage between the two.

name: HHWO United States Title
epitaph: The promotion's secondary singles belt, contested in a three-way match at the fed's first pay-per-view, Legends 98 (30 August 1998); its later lineage is not established in the documents read this pass.

name: HHWO Skyweight Title
epitaph: A title introduced after the fed's founding Handbook; held by "The Headliner" Scott Wright entering the Rocktober 98 card (18 October 1998), defended there in a Rabid Goat Death Match.

name: HHWO TV Title
epitaph: A title first seen at the Rocktober 98 card (18 October 1998) as a Barbed Wire Ladder Match, then defended in a three-way cage match at the fed's Rebirth show (15 November 1998).

name: HHWO North American Title
epitaph: A title introduced for the fed's second-era Rebirth show (15 November 1998), contested there in its own four-corners match.
